@@ -943,26 +943,80 @@ mod ComposeRealSum do
   # a float. Scoped to `d_func` (the inline `def f(p T) R := body` form); separate-clause
   # functions carry their param types in a sibling `d_sig` and are conservatively skipped
   # (a documented tail — the gate never false-rejects them, so v1==v2 is unaffected).
-  def first_num_mix(decls Vec(Tuple)) String
-  def first_num_mix([]) := ""
-  def first_num_mix([{:d_func, _, name, params, _, _, body} | rest])
+  # ── sig↔clause correlation (P3 d_clause widening) ──────────────────────────────────
+  # The type gates run on `d_func` (inline `def f(p T) R := body`) AND separate-clause
+  # functions: a `d_clause`'s param types + return live in its sibling `d_sig`, which
+  # `sig_index` collects so `clause_env` can pair the clause's VARIABLE patterns with the
+  # declared param types. A clause with no sibling sig is conservatively skipped (no types).
+  type SigOpt := SNone | SSome(Vec(Tuple), String)
+
+  def sig_index(Vec(Tuple)) Vec(Tuple)
+  def sig_index([]) := []
+  def sig_index([{:d_sig, _, name, params, ret, _} | rest]) := [{name, params, ret} | sig_index(rest)]
+  def sig_index([_ | rest]) := sig_index(rest)
+
+  def sig_lookup(Vec(Tuple), String) SigOpt
+  def sig_lookup([], _) := SNone
+  def sig_lookup([{n, params, ret} | rest], name)
+    if n == name do
+      SSome(params, ret)
+    else
+      sig_lookup(rest, name)
+    end
+  end
+
+  # a VARIABLE pattern binds {name -> the sig's positional param type}; any other pattern
+  # (literal/ctor/cons/wild) binds nothing — so its position infers `unknown` (conservative).
+  def clause_env(Vec(Tuple), Vec(Tuple)) Vec(Tuple)
+  def clause_env([], _) := []
+  def clause_env(_, []) := []
+  def clause_env([{:var, n} | ps], [{:par, _, _, t} | sps]) := [{n, t} | clause_env(ps, sps)]
+  def clause_env([_ | ps], [_ | sps]) := clause_env(ps, sps)
+
+  def first_num_mix(decls Vec(Tuple)) String := fnm(sig_index(decls), decls)
+
+  def fnm(Vec(Tuple), Vec(Tuple)) String
+  def fnm(_, []) := ""
+  def fnm(sigs, [{:d_func, _, name, params, _, _, body} | rest])
     if func_mixes(params, body) do
       name
     else
-      first_num_mix(rest)
+      fnm(sigs, rest)
     end
   end
-  def first_num_mix([{:d_mod, _, inner} | rest]) := mod_mix(first_num_mix(inner), rest)
-  def first_num_mix([_ | rest]) := first_num_mix(rest)
+  def fnm(sigs, [{:d_clause, name, pats, expr} | rest]) := clause_mix_or(sigs, name, pats, expr, rest)
+  def fnm(sigs, [{:d_clause_g, name, pats, _, expr} | rest]) := clause_mix_or(sigs, name, pats, expr, rest)
+  def fnm(sigs, [{:d_mod, _, inner} | rest]) := combine_mix(first_num_mix(inner), sigs, rest)
+  def fnm(sigs, [_ | rest]) := fnm(sigs, rest)
 
-  def mod_mix(inner String, rest Vec(Tuple)) String
+  def combine_mix(inner String, sigs Vec(Tuple), rest Vec(Tuple)) String
     if inner == "" do
-      first_num_mix(rest)
+      fnm(sigs, rest)
     else
       inner
     end
   end
 
+  def clause_mix_or(sigs Vec(Tuple), name String, pats Vec(Tuple), expr Tuple, rest Vec(Tuple)) String
+    case sig_lookup(sigs, name) do
+      SSome(params, _) -> clause_mix_decide(clause_mixes(params, pats, expr), name, sigs, rest)
+      SNone -> fnm(sigs, rest)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def clause_mix_decide(bad Bool, name String, sigs Vec(Tuple), rest Vec(Tuple)) String
+    if bad do
+      name
+    else
+      fnm(sigs, rest)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def clause_mixes(sigParams Vec(Tuple), pats Vec(Tuple), expr Tuple) Bool
+    env := clause_env(pats, sigParams)
+    Checker.num_mix(to_chk_block(lower_body(desugar_interp(env, expr))), tenv_dict(env), Prim.map_new())
+  end
+
   # lower the body to driver Core, project it onto checker.rian's Core, and ask the
   # locked `Checker.num_mix` under the clause's typed-param env (an empty `ic`: a mix
   # whose operand is a call to a float-returning function is the documented `ic` tail).

+  def fre(sigs, [{:d_clause, name, pats, expr} | rest]) := clause_ret_or(sigs, name, pats, expr, rest)

+  def combine_ret(inner String, sigs Vec(Tuple), rest Vec(Tuple)) String
     if inner == "" do

+  def clause_ret_or(sigs Vec(Tuple), name String, pats Vec(Tuple), expr Tuple, rest Vec(Tuple)) String
+    case sig_lookup(sigs, name) do
+      SSome(params, ret) -> clause_ret_decide(clause_ret_bad(params, ret, pats, expr), name, sigs, rest)
+      SNone -> fre(sigs, rest)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def clause_ret_decide(bad Bool, name String, sigs Vec(Tuple), rest Vec(Tuple)) String
+    if bad do
+      name
+    else
+      fre(sigs, rest)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def clause_ret_bad(sigParams Vec(Tuple), ret String, pats Vec(Tuple), expr Tuple) Bool
+    env := clause_env(pats, sigParams)
+    Checker.ret_bad(to_chk(block_result(lower_body(desugar_interp(env, expr)))), ret, tenv_dict(env), Prim.map_new())
+  end

   # unlike num_mix (which WALKS the body for a mix anywhere), the return gate needs the

@@ -107,15 +107,31 @@ defmodule Rian.ComposeTypeGateFixpointTest do
     end
   end
 
-  describe "documented boundary — the gate is scoped to d_func" do
-    test "a SEPARATE-CLAUSE function with a mix is NOT caught (the d_sig/d_clause tail)",
+  describe "d_clause widening — both gates also cover separate-clause functions (P3)" do
+    # `def f(a Int64) Float64` (a d_sig) + `def f(a) := a + 1.5` (a d_clause): the clause's
+    # param types come from its sibling sig (sig_index/clause_env), so the gates now bite on
+    # the common multi-clause form, not just inline `d_func`.
+    test "a separate-clause numeric mix is REFUSED", %{drv: drv} do
+      src = "def f(a Int64) Float64\ndef f(a) := a + 1.5"
+      assert catch_error(drv.compile_module(src, uniq(:ClauseMix))) == {:type_error, "f"}
+    end
+
+    test "a separate-clause return mismatch is REFUSED", %{drv: drv} do
+      src = "def g(a Int64) Float64\ndef g(a) := a"
+      assert catch_error(drv.compile_module(src, uniq(:ClauseRet))) == {:type_error, "g"}
+    end
+
+    test "a well-typed separate-clause function compiles + runs", %{drv: drv} do
+      m = drv.build("def h(a Int64) Int64\ndef h(a) := a + 1", uniq(:ClauseOk))
+      assert m.h(41) == 42
+    end
+
+    test "a clause with NO sibling sig is conservatively skipped (untyped → unknown)",
          %{drv: drv} do
-      # `def f(a Int64) Float64` (a d_sig) + `def f(a) := a + 1.5` (a d_clause) carries the
-      # same int↔float mix, but the gate only inspects inline `d_func` bodies — so this
-      # compiles today. Widening the gate to correlate a d_sig's param types with its
-      # d_clause bodies is the next increment; asserted here so the boundary is explicit.
-      m = drv.build("def f(a Int64) Float64\ndef f(a) := a + 1.5", uniq(:ClauseTail))
-      assert m.f(2) == 3.5
+      # no `d_sig` → the clause's `a` has no declared type → the gates can't prove anything,
+      # so it compiles even though `a + 1.5` would mix were `a` an Int.
+      m = drv.build("def k(a) := a + 1.5", uniq(:NoSig))
+      assert m.k(2) == 3.5
     end
   end
 end
